2317-7084-8249-8345.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

654-1309-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-1309-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-1309-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Salvager of Secrets and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2577-6664-7084-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-6664-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

575-1794-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6797-7753--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6797-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

620-2111-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

553-2093-6555.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Whirlwing Stormbrood // Dynamic Soar.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

567-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
567-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-1129-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-6968.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1308-5702--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
1308-5702--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1308-5702--143.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Anointed Procession.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Anointed Procession
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Anointed Procession.
Repeat from step 5.

1169-1563-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1169-1563-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1169-1563-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4050-4365-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-4365-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

2484-7502.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature on the battlefield.
2484-7502.description:
Cast Blasphemous Act by paying at most {7}{R}, dealing 13 damage to each creature.
Expedited Inheritance triggers for each creature dealt damage.
Resolve the first trigger, allowing the creature's controller to exile 13 cards from the top of their library with the ability until the end of their next turn
Repeat step 3 as needed for any remaining triggers.

147-5231-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5231-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5231-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

2097-4682-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
2097-4682-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
2097-4682-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1169-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3169-4659-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
3169-4659-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-5223-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1013-1491-5007.description:
Activate Morselhoarder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Morselhoarder by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

277-2653-2893-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Nissa and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

539-4693-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2275-3532-5078-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1492-2829-2866-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2829-2866-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1003-2173-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2178-3362-6542-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-6542-6797.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1170-1645-2499-5954-6763.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-5330-6291-6757.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2558-5330-6291-6757.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Atog to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

4543-5733-6333-6678.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4543-5733-6333-6678.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng from your graveyard by paying its prowl cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1580-2511-4871-5921.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

813-957-1567.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-1567.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

1458-3338--44.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate the creature by tapping it, returning the artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2099-2267-3263-3698.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in your graveyard.
2099-2267-3263-3698.description:
Activate Sarcatog's first ability by exiling two cards from your graveyard.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

567-1274-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-1274-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

5195-5895-5913.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Pinnacle Monk.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Pinnacle Monk.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2178-4147-4215-5256.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4147-4215-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4147-4215-5256.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2034-2178-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2178-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Repeat.

2068-2198-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2068-2198-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Deceiver Exarch and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Deceiver Exarch.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Deceiver Exarch from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1350-3263-4659-5432.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1350-3263-4659-5432.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents who each control at least one artifact.
1350-3263-4659-5432.description:
Cast Journey On either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1} and commander tax, if applicable, creating at least three Map artifact tokens and exiling Journey On with the ability to cast it from exile.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing three Maps, adding six {C}.
Cast Kellan from exile by paying {2}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {3}, returning Kellan from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you have at least three opponents who each control an artifact, once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Maps, and you may use the Maps to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

914-969-3036.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-969-3036.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1339-1926-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Insect.
"Insect" chosen with Species Specialist.
1339-1926-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
The Insect dies, triggering Species Specialist, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

1486-2158-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
1486-2158-3525.description:
Activate Magda by tapping it, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat for infinite Treasure tokens.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you can use them to activate Magda's ability to put all artifacts and Dragons in your library onto the battlefield.

224-1257-3257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.
